Policies.pageSubtitle: Comprehensive guidelines and cooperation terms designed to ensure transparency, fairness, and excellent service for all parties.

rentalPolicy.title: Rental Policy
rentalPolicy.description: Clear and fair guidelines that protect both landlords and tenants, ensuring a smooth rental experience for everyone.

items.title: Lease Duration
items.content: Minimum lease period is 3 months. Long-term leases (12+ months) are eligible for special discounts of 5-10% depending on the duration.

items.title: Payment Terms
items.content: Rent is due on the 1st of each month. Tenants can pay via bank transfer, e-payment, or cash at the office. A 5% late fee applies after 5 days.

items.title: Security Deposit
items.content: A security deposit equivalent to one month's rent is required. This deposit will be returned within 30 days after move-out, provided no damages occur.

items.title: Maintenance & Repairs
items.content: Landlord covers structural and major repairs. Tenant is responsible for small maintenance tasks and damages caused by negligence.

items.title: Termination Policy
items.content: Either party must provide 30 days written notice before termination. Early termination may incur penalties as per the lease agreement.

items.title: House Rules
items.content: Tenants must follow community rules: no excessive noise after 10 PM, no unauthorized renovations, keep common areas clean, and obtain approval for any structural changes.

rentalPolicy.importantText: All tenants and landlords must review and agree to these policies before entering into any rental agreement.

cooperationPolicy.title: Cooperation Policy
cooperationPolicy.description: Flexible partnership options with transparent revenue sharing. Choose the model that best fits your property management needs.

items.description: Standard Commission Split for Property Owners
details: Platform receives 30% as management and maintenance fee
Includes professional cleaning, tenant screening, and support
Includes 24/7 support, tenant management, and maintenance

cooperationPolicy.simpleText: No hidden fees. Revenue distribution is clear and calculated automatically every month.

policyDetails.title: Easy Cooperation Process
policyDetails.content: Free property assessment and customized partnership proposals. Sign cooperation agreements within 3-5 days. Simple, fast, and hassle-free process.

policyDetails.title: Professional Operations Management
policyDetails.content: List properties on major platforms with professional descriptions and photos. Direct tenant screening, verification, and lease signing. 24/7 customer care and quick issue resolution.

policyDetails.title: Transparent Revenue Reporting
policyDetails.content: Track real-time earnings through HomeIQ app. Monthly occupancy rates displayed in detail. Automatic bank transfer each month with no delays.

policyDetails.title: Property Maintenance & Repairs
policyDetails.content: Quick emergency response with 24/7 repair team ready. Property owners notified before repairs; approval required for major expenses. Full warranty coverage during lease period.

policyDetails.title: Professional Marketing & Promotion
policyDetails.content: List on all major platforms: Airbnb, Booking, Agoda, and real estate sites. Optimized advertising campaigns to increase views and bookings. Minimize vacancy periods between tenants.

policyDetails.title: Legal Support & Contracts
policyDetails.content: Provide legally compliant lease agreement templates. Legal consultation on rental-related matters. Protect property owner rights in tenant relationships.

step1.title: Register Your Property
step1.description: Create an account and list your apartment or room with detailed information and photos.

step2.title: Choose a Cooperation Plan
step2.description: Select the partnership model that suits your needs and management preferences.

step3.title: Earn Monthly Income
step3.description: Get paid automatically every month according to your chosen cooperation plan.

introduction.description: HomeIQ is a modern property management and rental platform that connects tenants with property owners through comprehensive digitization processes.

payment.deposit: The security deposit must equal 1-2 months of rent and is held throughout the lease period.
payment.methods: Pay via bank transfer, QR code, or e-wallet with no additional fees.
payment.reminder: Rent must be paid before the 1st of each month. A 5% late fee applies after 5 days of non-payment.
payment.receipt: Payment receipts are automatically sent via email upon confirmation.

refund.content: 30 days advance notice required. The security deposit is processed for return after inspection and debt reconciliation. Refunds processed within 5-7 business days.

update.content: HomeIQ reserves the right to update policies to comply with laws, market conditions, and development strategies. The latest version is always published transparently on our platform.
